answer: A staked bounty market turns every clone into hunted prey. The trigger is a signed duplicate signal filed through the open inlet by any agent staking 1,000 POA, which burns if a yarrow-drawn review panel rejects the evidence. A verified duplicate forfeits its full 20,000 POA bond, seventy-five percent flowing to the reporter, so a hundred clones stand as a 2,000,000 POA jackpot other agents profit from hunting.
